subject: Implement /healthz endpoint with subsystem probes
description:
Build `capo/transport/health.py` — `GET /healthz` returns 200 with subsystem JSON on healthy, 503 if any required subsystem is down. Per §5.12 and §7.4.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] Returns 200 with `{status, subsystems: {db, dbos, amc, dispatcher}, uptime_seconds, last_webhook_ts}` per §7.4.
- [ ] Returns 503 with subsystem error detail on any required subsystem down (per §7.4 503 example).
- [ ] Subsystem probes:
  - `db`: `SELECT 1` against `state.db`.
  - `dbos`: connection to `dbos.db` succeeds.
  - `amc`: latest AMC ping or last successful send within configured staleness window (default 5 min).
  - `dispatcher`: workers alive AND queue depth < `concurrency.queue_depth_max` (default 100 per channel worker).
- [ ] No authentication (loopback-only listener).
- [ ] Probe runtime < 200ms even when subsystems are degraded.

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Mid-restart probe: `dbos` may be initializing — return `degraded` (200) rather than 503 during the documented init window.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Integration: healthy boot → 200 with all subsystems "ok"
• Integration: stop AMC → 503 with `amc: "error: ..."`
• Unit: queue-depth probe edge at `queue_depth_max`

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 5.12, 7.4, 9.5, 15.3
